site.name: Car Mod Review
site.tagline: Car parts, tested against the marketing
site.audience: US car, truck, and SUV owners researching bolt-on upgrades before buying

notes: Dates on posts must reflect the actual publish date. Backdating is not permitted.
last_updated: is the authority for dateModified, <lastmod> and the byline. Raise it when the prose changes, not when a commit merely touches the file. A mechanical commit must never move a date.
Publishing a date older than the work it describes is the same failure in the other direction. The build reports drift; only a human can tell a revision from a mechanical edit.
Every post must state what it could not verify.

monetization.plan: Apply to AmericanTrucks in-house program once photography exists
monetization.rule: No rel=sponsored tag and no affiliate disclosure claim may appear until AFFILIATE_ID is set in build.py. Tagging a link sponsored before a real relationship exists is a false statement to Google and to readers.
